description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named ReferenceController, which provides endpoints for retrieving reference data such as provinces, country names, zone names, credit card expiration years, and months. It interacts with various services to fetch geographical and language-related data, and utilizes caching to improve performance.

classes.name: ReferenceController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling various reference data requests such as provinces, country and zone names, and credit card date options.

methods.name: getProvinces
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve a list of provinces (zones) for a specified country code and language.

methods.name: countryName
methods.description: Returns the localized name of a country given its country code, based on the request's language.

methods.name: zoneName
methods.description: Returns the localized name of a zone (state/region) given its zone code, based on the request's language.

methods.name: getCreditCardDates
methods.description: Provides a list of upcoming years for credit card expiration, cached for efficiency.

methods.name: getMonthsOfYear
methods.description: Returns a list of month strings (01-12) for use in credit card expiration date selection, with caching.
